chapter_mission: Ben and Talon arrive on Iresh. The Foundation/Vigil expedition is already present under legitimate cover. The book’s texture shifts from Coruscant conspiracy to strange-world expedition: wind, pale cliffs, dark water, chimes, black reeds, thin settlement lights, suspicious locals, and too much quiet. A local contact sends them to Sela Dray. Before they ask for help, the reader sees Sela in the middle of ordinary local responsibility: repairing a chime line, arguing over supply access, helping a neighbor, fixing a path marker, or dealing with someone asking about Tavi. Sela refuses Ben and Talon at first because offworlders have already harmed her home. Tavi Dray is missing after taking Foundation money or pressure to guide the expedition. The Foundation has blocked paths, ignored local warnings, brought armed security, and disrupted supply/transport access. Sela eventually agrees to help because finding Tavi and stopping the offworlders overlap.
chapter_turn: Sela agrees to help — on her terms, not theirs.
